# BTS member V creates history by becoming Instagram’s most-followed male K-pop soloist  
## BTS member V, aka Kim Taehyung, has made history by becoming the most-followed male K-pop solo artist on Instagram with over 75 million followers.  
**New Delhi:** BTS member [Kim Taehyung](https://www.news9live.com/entertainment/korean/bts-to-perform-at-fifa-world-cup-2026-final-halftime-show-confirms-rm-during-concert-2986585), popularly known as [V](https://www.news9live.com/entertainment/korean/bts-v-debuts-new-brown-hair-at-busan-soundcheck-and-it-breaks-the-internet-2979623), has now become the first male K-pop solo artist to reach the most-followed account on Instagram.  
The K-pop star enjoys one of the highest engagement rates on social media globally, ranking just behind international stars including Taylor Swift and Selena Gomez.
## BTS V achieves new milestone  
[BTS](https://www.news9live.com/entertainment/korean/please-stop-coming-to-our-hotels-bts-vs-plea-leaves-army-furious-and-heartbroken-2985642) member V has created history by becoming the first male K-pop solo artist to surpass 75 million followers on Instagram, making his account the most followed among K-pop soloists.  
Nearly six months ago, he surpassed 70 million followers on Instagram in January, marking an additional five million followers on the photo-sharing app.  
He made his debut on Instagram on December 6, 2021 and reached the 10 million followers mark within just four hours of opening the account.  
The second most followed individual on Instagram is of another BTS member, Jimin, who has over 58 million followers.  
> [A post shared by V (@thv)]()  
Currently, his Instagram account features 150 posts, including snippets from his ongoing Arirang concert, glimpses of his personal life and brand campaigns.  
His profile picture has an adorable picture of his late pet dog Yeontan, a Pomeranian who passed away in 2024 after suffering from prolonged illness.
## About Arirang tour  
BTS members V, RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, and Jungkook, are touring globally for their Arirang Tour. The K-pop idols are also set to perform at the FIFA World Cup’s halftime show.  
They are also enjoying the chart-topping success of their newly realeased album, Arirang. It was released on March 20 and became the first act tpo take over the entire 10 spots on the Billboard Global Exclusive US Chart and top 9 on the Billboard 200 during its debut week. Some of the songs are ‘Swim’, ‘Body to Body’, ‘Hooligan’, ‘Fya’, and ‘Normal’, among others.

results.name: BTS's V becomes the fastest person in the world to hit 70 Million followers on Instagram | allkpop
results.content:
Global K-pop icon[V](https://www.allkpop.com/artisttag/v) of [BTS](https://www.allkpop.com/artisttag/bts)has set another huge milestone, becoming the **fastest person** in the world to reach **70 million followers** on Instagram.  
His official account, [@thv](https://www.instagram.com/thv/), achieved the feat with just **150 posts**, underscoring his exceptional influence on the platform.  
With 70 million followers, V stands as the **most-followed male Korean soloist** on Instagram and the second most-followed Korean male act overall, after his own group, BTS, whose official account has 77 million followers.  
Since BTS members launched their personal Instagram accounts in December 2021, V has consistently dominated the platform, ranking among the most engaged and influential accounts globally.  
He previously earned [two Guinness World Records](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2021/12/bts-v-breaks-two-world-records-with-instagram-followers) for becoming the fastest person to reach **1 million and 10 million Instagram followers**, both within hours of joining, and has since maintained that momentum.  
According to a post by**HYPEBEAST Korea**, V also holds the record for the **most-liked Instagram post by a Korean in 2025**.  
The post shared during his military service amassed **17.7 million likes**, further highlighting his enduring global popularity despite reduced activity during his 18-month mandatory military enlistment.
This latest milestone reinforces Taehyung’s status not only as a leading artist but as a powerful cultural figure in the digital era.  
Congratulations, BTS's V!

BTS member V has achieved a remarkable milestone, becoming the first male K-pop star to amass 75 million Instagram followers. This feat is all the more impressive considering the competition, as V now ranks second among male pop stars, just behind Justin Bieber. His rapid rise to fame is a testament to his global appeal and the power of social media in the music industry.  
V's journey to this milestone began in December 2021 when he, along with the rest of the BTS members, opened their Instagram accounts. The group's collective influence and V's individual charisma quickly attracted a massive following. In just over a month, V surpassed 1 million followers, and in less than five hours, he hit 10 million, both of which earned him Guinness World Records. These records highlight the unprecedented speed at which V gained popularity and the level of engagement his social media presence generated.  
The impact of V's social media presence extends beyond numbers. During the European leg of BTS' tour, V attended Celine's spring/summer 2027 menswear show in Paris, which generated approximately 22 million social media interactions in 24 hours. This demonstrates the significant influence V has on fashion and the entertainment industry, as his presence at the event attracted a massive online audience and sparked widespread interest.
V's success on Instagram is a reflection of his multifaceted talent and global appeal. As a member of one of the most successful K-pop groups, BTS, V has already achieved immense success with his music. However, his Instagram presence showcases a different side of his personality and allows him to connect directly with his fans. This direct connection is a powerful tool for artists to build a loyal following and maintain a strong presence in the digital age.  
The fact that V is the first male K-pop star to reach 75 million followers is a significant achievement, but it also raises questions about the future of the industry. As social media continues to play a pivotal role in the music business, it will be interesting to see how other artists adapt and compete. V's success suggests that a strong social media presence is not just a bonus but a necessity for artists looking to maintain relevance and connect with their global audience.  
In conclusion, V's achievement of 75 million Instagram followers is a testament to his talent, charisma, and the power of social media. It also highlights the evolving nature of the music industry and the importance of a strong online presence. As V continues to dominate the charts and captivate audiences worldwide, his influence on the industry is set to grow, leaving a lasting impact on the world of K-pop and beyond.

results.name: From BTS to Coldplay: 11 Bands With The Most (Collective) Instagram Followers - Newsweek
results.content:
K-pop sensation BTS have announced they'll be taking an ["official extended period of rest" to get "re-inspired and recharge with creative energy"](https://twitter.com/BIGHIT_MUSIC/status/1467660058276282369/photo/2) following the completion of their final scheduled work commitments this year.  
Their latest gigs took place in Los Angeles, including their [2021 Jingle Ball show in early December](https://twitter.com/bts_bighit/status/1466950381359960068) and their concerts at the [SoFi Stadium as part of their "Permission To Dance On Stage - LA" tour in late November and early December.](https://www.newsweek.com/bts-permission-dance-tour-sofi-los-angeles-dates-tickets-1633411)  
The global K-pop band has one of the biggest fan bases in the world. But how many followers do BTS and other major artists have on [Instagram](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/instagram)? Here we round up some of the band accounts with the most followers on the social media platform.
## 1. BTS  
### Instagram followers: 54.5 million  
The global boy band has amassed one of the largest numbers of followers on Instagram since their debut in 2013.  
Within hours of the announcement of the band's temporary hiatus, each BTS member also [launched an individual Instagram account](https://www.newsweek.com/bts-instagram-accounts-official-members-launch-announcing-break-1656269).  
Their verified accounts each attracted [more than four million followers within hours, with BTS member V bagging the most by 11 a.m. ET at 4.5 million.](https://www.newsweek.com/bts-instagram-accounts-official-members-launch-announcing-break-1656269)
## 2. Blackpink  
### Instagram followers: 43.7 million  
The [chart-topping K-pop stars](https://www.billboard.com/artist/blackpink/) are one of the [biggest girl groups in the world](https://www.instagram.com/blackpinkofficial/). Their record-breaking songs have made [YouTube history](https://www.billboard.com/pro/blackpink-timeline-history-making-accomplishments/) and set [Guinness World Records](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2020/6/blackpinks-return-sets-new-youtube-records-with-how-you-like-that-622453).
